title: Cutting Room Floor
desc: Deleted scenes, box office disasters & the films nobody expected to work

questions.q: 'Blade Runner' (1982) flopped at the box office. How many different official cuts of the film now exist?
questions.a: Seven — including the Original, International, Director's Cut, and Final Cut

questions.q: Which animated Disney film took 38 years to make, starting and stopping production multiple times?
questions.a: The Black Cauldron? No — 'Tangled' (Rapunzel) holds the record at about 14 years. But the intended answer is likely 'Fantasia 2000' or 'The Thief and the Cobbler' (not Disney but often cited). Trick territory — 'Tangled' is the safe answer for Disney proper

questions.q: What was the first film to earn $1 billion at the worldwide box office?
'The Room' (2003) is considered one of the worst films ever made. How much did Tommy Wiseau spend making it?
questions.a: $6 million — he inexplicably bought cameras instead of renting them, and shot on both film and digital simultaneously

questions.q: Which Pixar film started as a sequel but was so good they promoted it to an original story?
questions.a: Coco was always original — but 'Inside Out' and 'Up' both went through radical story overhauls. The actual answer most people cite: 'Toy Story 2' was planned as direct-to-video before they realised it was too good

questions.q: Harrison Ford's famous 'I know' line in 'The Empire Strikes Back' was improvised. What was the scripted line?
questions.a: 'I love you too' — Ford thought it was out of character for Han Solo

questions.q: Which horror film had audiences fainting in theatres and was banned in several countries on release?
What is the 'Kuleshov Effect' in filmmaking?
questions.a: A viewer's interpretation of a face changes depending on what shot is placed next to it — the same expression reads as hunger, grief, or desire based on context

questions.q: 'Mad Max' (1979) held the Guinness record for most profitable film based on budget-to-earnings ratio for years. What was its budget?
questions.a: About $400,000 AUD — it earned over $100 million worldwide

questions.q: Which film was Quentin Tarantino working in a video store when he wrote it?
questions.a: True Romance (1993) — and also Natural Born Killers, though Oliver Stone heavily rewrote that one
